scope: Static production JavaScript asset sizes only. The original matched-build localization differential is retained as historical evidence; a separate absolute production-bundle ceiling is measured for the current application. Neither measurement covers loading time, authenticated behavior, server cost, or production capacity.

productionBuildCeiling.basis: Absolute ceiling for the complete current SvelteKit production JavaScript bundle after the application policy explorer was added. Two consecutive builds with the same source revision produced byte-identical static output. The 1 KiB headroom allows small build-identifier compression differences and is not a matched English-only localization comparison.

notes: The baseline values and English-only revision are from the comparable presentation measurement in localization-2026-09-26.json.

The original matched-build differential is 36,328 gzip bytes under its 36,864-byte allowance, with 536 bytes of headroom. Its English-only baseline predates the policy explorer now in the current application, so it must not be used as the current whole-application bundle baseline.

After the policy explorer, the current production JavaScript bundle is 688,106 raw / 224,509 gzip bytes. Two builds at source revision fcd00f6971f49b1e5de77d098422a8eab0180224 had byte-identical output after the SvelteKit app version was made deterministic. The build-time whole-application ceiling is 225,533 gzip bytes (the measured bundle plus 1 KiB of headroom); a fresh matched English-only build is still required to re-qualify the localization differential for current source.
The test-only pseudolocale lives outside the production src tree and its identifier was absent from the built static output.
Cold/warm observations remain in localization-2026-09-26.json; this report records the later asset-only rebuild and makes no latency claim.
